Restriction to vertical invariant surface over base curve C is -2E+(K_B·C-|L·C|)f on F_|L·C|, and anti-big iff |L·C|>K_B·C; only negative base section S can impose nonautomatic strip |b-ma|>m-2 when m>=2. All invariant-curve degrees are nonzero except specified m=0/1 exceptional |δ|=2/1, and the toric orbit-closure criterion is necessary/sufficient for tensor-generation. On D=F_h the zero-canonical-degree multisection pE+qf obeys 2q=p(κ+h); since q>=ph and p>=1, minimum p=1 if κ+h even, 2 otherwise, with basepoint-free systems supplying smooth irreducible witnesses, and adjunction gives genera 0 and m-3. Independent exact integer test over 16,104 parameter triples m=0..7,a=-16..16,b=-30..30 compared direct orbit-closure conditions with claimed formula (zero disagreements; 5322 generating), and checked parity/genus sample, as finite corroboration only. n=negative excluded, all a,b allowed; n=0? m>=0 correct.
